results.title: GTA warns hotels, transport operators against excessive pricing ahead of December in GH
results.content: The Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) has cautioned hotels and transport operators against excessive price increases ahead of the 2026 December in GH festivities, warning that unreasonable rates could discourage visitors and undermine business. The Authority has also called on event organisers to engage security and emergency services early to ensure adequate preparations for the expected influx of visitors during the festive season. The appeals were made at a stakeholder engagement in Accra involving hoteliers, tour operators, event organisers and representatives of key state institutions, including the Ghana Police Service, Ghana National Fire Service, National Ambulance Service, Ghana Immigration Service and Ghana Revenue Authority. results.title: Ghana recorded 2,100 AMR-related deaths in 2019, experts warn of farm-related risks
results.content: Ghana recorded an estimated 2,100 deaths attributable to antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in 2019, with experts warning that inappropriate antibiotic use in livestock and fish farming could worsen the country's public health burden. Animal health expert Dr Benjamin Kissi Sasu says the misuse of antimicrobials in food production, poor farm hygiene and inadequate waste management could accelerate the spread of drug-resistant infections. He warns that unsafe practices on farms could expose consumers to antibiotic residues in animal products, while contaminated waste could spread resistant organisms through the environment. Speaking on the threat posed by antimicrobial resistance in Ghana's food value chain, Dr Sasu said the issue should concern consumers because animal products form part of many people's diets. results.title: Kow Essuman accuses Finance Minister, AG of ignoring letters over unpaid entitlements
results.content: Former legal counsel to President Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, Kow Essuman, has criticised the Attorney-General and Finance Minister for failing to respond to his demands for payment of outstanding salary arrears and end-of-service benefits.
